content.value_statement: Product Hunt launches require precise timing, clear positioning, and strong visuals. This skill gives teams a structured checklist for listing copy, gallery assets, comments, research, and launch day execution.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes Product Hunt listing requirements, including tagline length, gallery limits, topics, makers, and product links.
Recommends gallery image order, dimensions, and content themes for launch pages.
Provides tagline formulas and examples for clear product positioning.
Outlines launch timing, maker comment structure, and engagement actions for launch day.
Suggests research prompts and related belt app commands for launch preparation.
limitations: It does not submit products to Product Hunt or manage an account.
It cannot guarantee ranking, upvotes, press coverage, or community response.
Generated image prompts and research commands may need review for brand accuracy.
Product Hunt rules and interface details may change after the skill content was written.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Startup Launch
use_cases.description: Create a Product Hunt listing plan with tagline, gallery sequence, maker comment, and launch day timeline.

use_cases.title: Package a Side Project
use_cases.description: Turn a small product into a clearer launch story with concise positioning and practical asset guidance.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Launch Operations
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to assign copy, visuals, support replies, social posts, and post-launch follow-up tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Launch Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new Product Hunt submission.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a Product Hunt launch for [product name]. The product helps [audience] solve [problem]. Create a tagline, gallery outline, maker comment draft, and launch day checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Listing Positioning
prompt_templates.scenario: Refine copy before submitting the launch page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Product Hunt listing draft: [paste draft]. Improve the tagline, short description, topic choices, and first gallery image concept while keeping the message clear.

prompt_templates.title: Build Gallery Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan visual assets for a launch page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-image Product Hunt gallery plan for [product]. Include the goal of each image, the visible product state, and a concise generation prompt for each image.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Launch Readiness Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Product Hunt launch plan for [product]. Check timing, tagline, gallery order, maker comment, outreach plan, engagement rules, and post-launch follow-up. List risks and fixes.

output_examples.input: A founder needs a launch checklist for an analytics product.
output: A recommended Tuesday through Thursday launch window at 12:01 AM Pacific Time.
A concise tagline focused on the analytics outcome, not internal technology.
A five-image gallery plan showing product value, feature proof, and social proof.
A maker comment structure with problem, solution, differentiator, and feedback request.

output_examples.input: A maker asks for gallery guidance for a small developer tool.
output: First image: product in use with the core workflow visible.
Second image: the fastest path to the main result.
Third image: before-and-after comparison showing saved effort.
Later images: integrations, metrics, or technical differentiators.

output_examples.input: A marketing lead wants to improve launch day engagement.
output: A timeline for posting, sharing updates, checking comments, and replying through the full Product Hunt day.
Guidance to share naturally and avoid asking for upvotes.
Follow-up tasks for comments, lessons learned content, and interested users.

best_practices: Start with a clear audience and outcome before writing the tagline or gallery prompts.
Show real product value in the first gallery image because it appears across Product Hunt surfaces.
Prepare replies, social posts, and follow-up tasks before launch day begins.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague superlatives or buzzwords that hide what the product does.
Do not ask people for upvotes because it can violate Product Hunt rules.
Do not rely on generic gallery images that fail to show the actual product workflow.

faq.question: Does this skill submit my product to Product Hunt?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan launch materials and tactics, but submission remains a manual Product Hunt workflow.

faq.question: Can it create gallery image prompts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for hero, feature, before-and-after, social proof, and differentiator images.

faq.question: Does it require the belt CLI?
faq.answer: The written guidance works without belt. Some optional research and image examples use belt commands.

faq.question: Will this guarantee a top Product Hunt ranking?
faq.answer: No. It improves preparation and clarity, but ranking depends on product fit, timing, audience, and community response.

faq.question: Is it suitable for non-SaaS products?
faq.answer: Yes. The launch structure can support many product types, but some gallery examples are SaaS-focused.

faq.question: Can teams use it for launch coordination?
faq.answer: Yes. The checklist and timeline can help assign copy, visuals, posting, replies, and follow-up tasks.
